song.title: Prendre Un Enfant Par La Main

guitar.evidence: Yves Duteil is a French singer-songwriter performing on acoustic guitar; no specific iconic model documented.

tone.target: soft clean accompaniment, minimal FX, vocal support
tone.profile: soft clean accompaniment, minimal FX, vocal support
tone.summary: A highly clean signal chain using a Fender-style amp (US Deluxe) with minimal pre-gain boost, followed by a clear cab and subtle room reverb to support delicate fingerpicking.

rig.name: Yves Duteil - Prendre Un Enfant Par La Main - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum inherent in sparse acoustic/fingerpicking styles.
blocks.gap: None. Standard practice for clean tones.

blocks.purpose: Gentle dynamic leveling to ensure consistent volume for delicate picking dynamics without adding noticeable compression artifacts.
blocks.gap: The 'no compression artifacts' rule conflicts with using a compressor. Using it gently (low ratio/high threshold) is the best compromise for evenness.

alternatives.reason: If pure clean signal integrity is paramount, Boost could be used instead of Comp to simply raise volume without shaping dynamics.

blocks.purpose: Bypass gain stages entirely to maintain a pristine clean tone.
blocks.gap: N/A. The target requires zero distortion or crunch.

blocks.purpose: Simulate a classic Fender-style clean amp known for its open, clear tone suitable for accompaniment.
blocks.gap: The US Deluxe is the best choice among available amps for pure, non-aggressive clean tones.

alternatives.reason: A good alternative if the tone needs to be slightly more robust than the US Deluxe.

blocks.purpose: Provide a clear, bright cabinet sound that complements the US Deluxe amp model.
blocks.gap: None. Standard pairing for clean Fender tones.

blocks.purpose: Subtly shape the frequency response to enhance clarity and vocal support without sounding artificial.
blocks.gap: None. Used for final tone sculpting.

blocks.purpose: Bypass the wah stage as it is not required for a clean accompaniment tone.
blocks.gap: N/A. The target requires minimal FX.

blocks.purpose: Bypass all modulation effects (Chorus/Tremolo) as they are explicitly avoided.
blocks.gap: N/A. The target requires minimal FX.

blocks.purpose: Bypass delay effects as they are explicitly avoided.
blocks.gap: N/A. The target requires minimal FX.

blocks.purpose: Provide subtle room ambience to give the accompaniment depth without sounding wet or distracting.
blocks.gap: None. Room reverb is ideal for natural, supportive ambiance.

alternatives.reason: If a slightly more controlled and less 'natural' ambience was desired.

blocks.purpose: Final output level adjustment to ensure the accompaniment sits perfectly in the mix with the vocals.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism for better acoustic support.
